deer-portrait.png.comment: Great colour energy and a strong stare, but the antlers are cut off at the top edge. The splatter on the left is busy where desktop icons sit.

pins.note: Antler tips cut off by the frame
Nose and eyes are crisp, focal point works
Busy splatter right where desktop icons go

hummingbird.png.comment: Nice composition with the bird on the right third, and the paint drips are a good touch. The beak points at empty space instead of the flowers, so the bird looks pasted in.

pins.note: Beak points at nothing, aim it at the flower
Wing is softer than the head

peacock.png.comment: Best of the set. Symmetric fan, rich colour, lots of black around it so it crops well to any screen. Use as the hero image.

pins.note: Fan top has room to breathe

lion.png.comment: Strong symmetric stare and the red mane reads well on a dark desktop. The whiskers turn into noise on the right.

pins.note: Mane cut at the top, fine for a wallpaper

red-eyed-tree-frog.png.comment: The red eye carries the whole image and the body dissolving into splatter works. Plenty of empty black at the bottom for a taskbar.

poison-dart-frog.png.comment: Moody and dark, the back pattern is crisp. The left half is empty, which leaves room for desktop icons. The eye could use a highlight.

pins.note: Yellow and red back pattern is great
Eye barely readable, add a catchlight

anglerfish.png.comment: The glowing lure is a great focal point and the colour on the body is lovely. The fish sits low-left; it would need a crop for ultrawide screens.

pins.note: Tail edge gets lost against the blue

hedgehog-sunflowers.png.comment: Cosy, painterly look with a subtle swirling sky. The sunflowers are the sharpest detail; the hedgehog's face is a bit flat.

pins.note: Face is flat, the eye needs a catchlight
Swirls in the sky: subtle and nice

great-white-shark.png.comment: The painterly style fits and the light rays are lovely, but the shark looks stiff, the pectoral fin is too long and the tail fades out.

pins.note: Pectoral fin too long, bends oddly

great-blue-heron.png.comment: Elegant silhouette and the pink reeds add colour, but the heron is dark blue on dark blue and almost disappears at desktop size.

pins.note: Pink splatter in the reeds: nice

lynx-in-snow.png.comment: Sharp amber eyes, lovely fur texture and the pine branches frame it well. The splatter fades nicely into the dark edges.

pins.note: Snow at the bottom is a bit muddy

phoenix.png.comment: Huge energy, warm palette and drips that run into black. Works on any screen size; strong candidate for the hero image.

red-crowned-cranes.png.comment: Nice pairing and the red crowns pop, but the bodies dissolve into mush and the legs are cut off at the bottom. Redo with a cleaner render.

pins.note: Legs cut off by the frame
